evidence: Graesse, Orbis Latinus s.v. Corcoras: Corcoras, Labachus, Labacum, Laybacum, Aemona, Emonensis civ., Tauriscorum col., Laibach
terms.comment: Formed on Laibach, the German name of the city. A town takes no preposition: Labacum (to), Labacī (in, at), Labacō (from).

evidence: Plin. NH 3.147: in eā colōniae Emona, Siscia
Graesse, Orbis Latinus s.v. Corcoras: Corcoras, Labachus, Labacum, Laybacum, Aemona, Emonensis civ., Tauriscorum col., Laibach
terms.comment: The Roman colony of Pannonia, which Graesse places at Ljubljana (he spells it Aemona). Lewis & Short has no entry for it; its quantities are not established and are left unmarked.

sources: The Latin Library texts (thelatinlibrary.com), read in a local copy, for ancient passages not quoted in Lewis & Short; cited by book and section.

J. G. Th. Graesse, Orbis Latinus, edition of F. Benedict (1909), Latin–German, read in the digitization at columbia.edu (cited as Graesse, Orbis Latinus s.v.); its forms are post-classical unless Lewis & Short has them.
